Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881: Section 138 and explanation thereto-Dishonour of cheque drawn in C respect of debt or liability for amount advanced earlier-Proceedings under the Section-Magistrate issued summons to the accused-Accused filed revision petition alleging that complaint was not quashed the proceedings-On appeal, held, debt or liability not barred from D being enforced under law-At the stage of issue of summons, it is incorrect to hold that such debt or liability not legally enforceable--Matter remanded to the Magistrate.
